form_name: Titre de séjour — mention salarié or travailleur temporaire
non_obvious_official_guidance: Non-EU/EEA nationals requiring a titre de séjour apply via the ANEF platform (administration-etrangers-en-france.interieur.gouv.fr), which replaced in-person préfecture appointments from 2021–2022.
non_obvious_actual_reality: ANEF has documented reliability issues: pages that don't load, upload errors, sessions timing out without saving progress. The platform is mandatory — you cannot bypass it by going to the préfecture in person — but it's unreliable enough that applying 30 days before the move date fails routinely. HR teams that apply close to the deadline frequently experience 10–15 day processing gaps caused by platform failures, not case complexity.
non_obvious_action_required: Apply minimum 60 days before move date — not 30. Screenshot every completed page and every confirmation email. Save all reference numbers immediately. If the portal returns an error, document it with timestamp — this is evidence for a préfecture complaint if needed. Do not treat submission as processing confirmation.
source: CESEDA (Code de l'Entrée et du Séjour des Étrangers); ANEF platform

field_label: Titre de séjour expiry date (renewal trigger)
deadline_label: Renewal application minimum 60 days before expiry
non_obvious_official_guidance: Titre de séjour holders must renew via ANEF before the card expires. The application should be submitted 2–3 months before expiry.
non_obvious_actual_reality: An expired titre de séjour means the employee has no right to work from the expiry date — no grace period for the employer. HR teams that don't track expiry dates discover the problem when the employee is stopped at a border or during an internal audit. ANEF processing delays of 4–8 weeks are common — early submission is the difference between a late card and an illegal employment situation where the employer is liable.
non_obvious_action_required: HR owns a tracked field for fr.titre_sejour.expiry_date for every non-EU employee. Set automated alert at expiry minus 90 days. Initiate ANEF renewal application at expiry minus 60 days minimum. Do not allow the employee to self-manage this — the employer carries equal legal liability for employing someone with an expired titre.
